variants.name: .50 AE
variants.info:
Load your GB-22 with .50 AE.
 This makes it a GB-50. The larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried.

variants.name: Minishells
variants.info:
Somehow load your GB-22 with 12 gauge minishells.
 This makes it a GB-12.
More pellets for greater damage, but horrid muzzle velcoity and less ammunition carried.

variants.name: Tracerless
variants.info:
Ammo that doesn't have the components that create weapon tracers.

Greater overall accuracy for less range performance and bullet penetration.

variants.name: 10mm Auto
variants.info:
Load your GB-22 with 10mm Auto.
 This makes it a GB-10, the larger bullet brings greater damage, but worse recoil and less ammunition carried. Great velocity.

variants.name: Armor Piercing
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to green tipped armor piercing rounds.
Increases bullet penetration (+30%) and torso damage multiplier (+5%) but reduces damage up close (-5%) range (-5%) and head damage multiplier (-4%).

variants.name: Hollow Point
variants.info:
Changes your ammunition to hollow point rounds.
Increases damage up close (+15%), maximum damage range (+17.5%)!
But reduces torso multiplier (-15%), penetration (-62.5%) and bullet speed (-10%).
